audit.whatIsWrong: win[2]/phases[2].side said K'Sante while whys[2] opens with 'Even — ... a genuine coin-flip'. The packet chart also has Level 3 as Skill.
audit.why: Two layers rendered a confident K'Sante next to prose calling it even.
audit.corrected: Level 3 set to Skill in phases[2].side and win[2] together, rating 7/10 -> 5/10. Rows 4 and 5 already sit with Kassadin per the already-audited mirror; row 6 stays K'Sante where whys[6], spikes[3] and late agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'short-cooldown blink' with no number, in three places; the packet flags zero cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere in this matchup.
audit.why: Riftwalk is 5/3.5/2s and Path Maker 14/13/12/11/10s — the gap between them is the whole matchup and it was never stated.
audit.corrected: Riftwalk's 5s-at-rank-1 down to 2s-at-rank-3 written into spikes[1], whys[3] and the interactions row; Path Maker's 14s into spikes[0].

audit.whatIsWrong: Three fabrications. (1) 'Q silence-shield' twice — Null Sphere has no silence; Riot's text is damage, channel interrupt, and a magic-absorbing shield. (2) 'Q3 knock-pull' / 'Q3 knock-up-and-pull' / 'Q3-knockup' — Ntofo Strikes has no third-hit knockup; at 2 stacks it fires a shockwave that PULLS. (3) 'His passive AP shield' — Void Stone is flat reduced magic damage and unit-collision ignore, not a shield.
audit.why: Kit text is the authority and the mirror already recorded the same three errors from Kassadin's side.
audit.corrected: Silence removed, the pull corrected to two-stack Ntofo Strikes, and Void Stone described as magic damage reduction with the shield placed on Null Sphere where it belongs. Nether Blade's auto-attack reset (7s) added as the burst tell.

edits.before: Kassadin is meleed-down hard at Level 1 with only his Q, and I out-position him on the wave — I farm safely and deny his last-hits without walking into the Q silence-shield.
edits.after: Kassadin is meleed-down hard at Level 1 with only Null Sphere, and I out-position him on the wave — I farm safely and deny his last-hits without eating his Q shield.

edits.before: Even — my full Q3 knock-pull all-in chunks him, but his Q silence-shield and the fact he can sit back and farm make it a genuine coin-flip on whether he gives me the trade.
edits.after: Even — my two-stack Ntofo Strikes pull all-in chunks him, but Null Sphere's magic shield and his ability to sit back and farm make it a coin-flip whether he trades at all.

edits.before: Riftwalk arrives: his short-cooldown blink slips out of my W stun and dodges the Q3 pull, so my lockdown loses its target and the lane starts tilting to him.
edits.after: Riftwalk arrives: a 5s blink slips out of my W stun and dodges the Ntofo Strikes pull, so my lockdown loses its target and the lane starts tilting to him.

edits.before: My Q-W combo comes fully online — I can W-charge into a committed Kassadin and Q3 knock-pull him while he's still a meleed-down assassin with no Riftwalk escape.
edits.after: My Q-W combo comes fully online — Path Maker (14s) charges into a committed Kassadin and the two-stack Ntofo pull follows, while he still has no Riftwalk escape.

edits.before: Kassadin's turning point: Riftwalk gives him a short-cooldown blink that slips out of my W stun and Q3 pull, so my lockdown loses its target and he starts to scale away.
edits.after: Kassadin's turning point: Riftwalk is a 5s blink at rank 1 falling to 2s at rank 3 — it slips my W stun and the Ntofo pull, so my lockdown loses its target.

edits.before: Kassadin is meleed-down and miserable levels 1-3, and I'm built to punish exactly that. At Level 1 I only have Q, so I just farm and don't walk into his Q silence-shield for free. The lane turns at Level 2-3 when my W Path Maker and Q-W combo come online: if he steps up to last-hit, I W-charge in, knock him back, and Q3 knock-pull him for a real chunk while he still has no Riftwalk to escape. His passive AP shield blunts my magic poke, so commit with the full combo, not single Q pokes.
edits.after: Kassadin is meleed-down and miserable levels 1-3, and I'm built to punish exactly that. At Level 1 I only have Q, so I farm and don't walk into Null Sphere for free. The lane turns at Level 2-3 when Path Maker and the Q-W combo come online: if he steps up to last-hit, I W-charge in, knock him back, and land the two-stack Ntofo Strikes pull for a real chunk while he has no Riftwalk to escape. Void Stone cuts my magic damage and his Q leaves a shield, so commit with the full combo, not single pokes.

edits.after: Reach Level 6 Riftwalk to blink out of my W stun and Ntofo pull, then snowball a 5s blink down to a 2s one in skirmishes

edits.before: Track Kassadin's Riftwalk: His mobility spike at 6. Kill him before it scales. When it is down — Q3-knockup, All Out the duel.
edits.after: Riftwalk is 5s at rank 1 and 2s at rank 3. His burst opens with a Nether Blade auto reset (7s) — step back on the wind-up, not on the cast.

notes: REJECTED one supplied missing-interaction: 'Kassadin's Null Sphere (Q) is a channel — your Q/W cancels it outright.' The channel flag is a tooltip-parsing misfire — Riot's text says Null Sphere INTERRUPTS channels, it is not itself one. Nothing written claiming you can cancel his Q. Packet chart also has Levels 4-5 as Kassadin, but the mid prose and the already-audited mirror both treat 4-5 as K'Sante's lane-control peak, so that row was left alone rather than flipped against the mirror — flagged in questions.
